_meta.methodology: Implicit conflicts only — the user never issues an explicit 'update X to Y' command; the reflection subagent must detect the conflict on its own. Each case run N times across multiple Bedrock models. Case A is the control and MUST pass for a run to be considered valid.
_meta.note_on_prompt_modification: The verbatim reflection prompt is used, with a single appended instruction requiring the model to emit its memory decision as structured JSON so scoring is deterministic. This modification is disclosed in the report.
